standard_prerequisites.name: The automorphism group algebraic spaces of a point of an algebraic stack, and the equivalence relation on such points given by field extensions
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author's section on automorphism groups, in which the counted statement occurs
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the two maps whose being isomorphisms is asserted to be equivalent.

standard_prerequisites.name: The descent of the property of being an isomorphism along a faithfully flat and quasi-compact morphism
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 4030-4033) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the property propagates along a field extension, whence along the equivalence class of the point.

core_obligations: Base change along a field extension: for an extension of fields and the induced point the proof observes that the map of automorphism groups is the base change of the original map along the spectrum of the extension (proof lines 4034-4038)

Descent of the property: since being an isomorphism descends along the faithfully flat morphism given by the field extension, the original map is an isomorphism exactly when the base changed one is (proof lines 4030-4040)
Propagation through the class: hence the property holds for one point of the class exactly when it holds for every point of the class, which is the asserted equivalence (proof lines 4041-4042)
proof_roadmap: 设 k′/k 是域扩张，x′ 是 x 的复合，y′ = f∘x′；则 G_{x′} → G_{y′} 是 G_x → G_y 沿 Spec k′ → Spec k 的基变换。
由「同构沿忠实平坦态射下降」（跨章引理），G_x → G_y 是同构 ⟺ 其基变换是同构；于是该性质在点的等价类内传递，两种表述等价。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a point of an algebraic stack the property that the morphism induces an isomorphism between the automorphism group algebraic spaces of the point and of its image is independent of the representative chosen in the equivalence class of the point (author lemma at source lines 4013-4027, label lemma-iso-automorphism-groups). The proof (source lines 4029-4043) identifies the map for a base changed point with the base change of the original map along the field extension and invokes the descent of the property of being an isomorphism along faithfully flat morphisms, so that the property propagates through the class (proof lines 4030-4042). The base change identification with the descent step is the content. H2.
